niches.name: Ecommerce / online shop

niches.name: Local services

niches.name: SaaS / software
niches.note: Comparison and alternative keywords convert best here; the outline should include a feature table and a pricing section.

niches.name: Blogging / creators
niches.note: Informational intent: the brief should front-load the step-by-step outline and a FAQ section.

how to grow on instagram without ads

niches.note: Readers want templates and numbers, so the brief should ask for a downloadable template and real price ranges.
